company_profile: The role is with PwC's Data & AI Consulting team, advertised through Women in Data; the team builds AI products for clients, from pricing and forecasting to agentic AI.
title: Data Scientist - Manager
summary: Data scientist with 8+ years across the data science lifecycle in Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds forecasting, prediction and anomaly detection models and agentic AI with LangGraph, from feature engineering and validation to deployment with MLflow and Docker on Azure and GCP. Has delivered POCs and consulting for 15+ clients, explaining data clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Price Elasticity and Demand Forecasting
bullets: Built a reusable pricing and demand forecasting product estimating price elasticity per product segment with LightGBM and PyTorch, keeping feature design configurable across different client datasets.
Validated forecasts against Holt-Winters baselines on rolling backtests, explained price drivers to business users, and deployed on Azure with MLflow tracking and Git-based CI.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data Scientist - Manager role in PwC's Data & AI Consulting team. My data science work has moved from forecasting and prediction models to agentic AI, much of it built with and for clients. The thread is models that are rigorous enough to trust and simple enough to explain.

Building reusable AI products across many client contexts, from pricing to agents, is the kind of work I enjoyed most in consulting at Viavi. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

At Viavi I shipped anomaly detection and demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs across 500+ network devices, and delivered POCs and consulting for 15+ clients. At United Health Group I built a LangGraph multi-agent chatbot that cut manual analysis by 98%. I would bring that mix to your product squads.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me focused on responsible AI that its users can understand and trust. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
